parsed.reason: Both descriptions identify the same defect: Flask.run() uses server_name.partition(":") which splits an IPv6 SERVER_NAME like [::1]:8080 at the first colon, yielding host "[" and a malformed port string that makes int(sn_port) raise ValueError. Description A adds extra detail about the explicit-port case and bracketed address without port, but the root cause and location are the same as Description B.
